source: runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 花园实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Librarian (2026-08-24 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Librarian (一致)
note: 图书管理员,图书馆里卖附魔书的 NPC;作为花园访客时来要甘蔗造纸。文绉绉、有礼貌。大厅台词在 Hub_General/NPC_Message/Librarian.json。

messages.raw: §fGreetings! I've been running low on paper recently for my Enchanted Books, could you bring me some Sugar Cane?
messages.text: Greetings! I've been running low on paper recently for my Enchanted Books, could you bring me some Sugar Cane?
messages.zh: 你好! 我最近做附魔书的纸快用完了,能给我带些甘蔗来吗?

messages.raw: §fI'll be sure to make some Enchanted Books out of these, I hope you come around some day!
messages.text: I'll be sure to make some Enchanted Books out of these, I hope you come around some day!
messages.zh: 我一定用它们做出几本附魔书来,希望你哪天来坐坐!

messages.text: Very unfortunate, I really needed that paper...
messages.zh: 真遗憾,我是真的很需要那些纸……
